name: Fokask
description: Fokask was a planet within the Fokask system in Outer Rim Territories. It was home to one of Han Solo's old smuggling friends. This retired smuggler sent Solo a copy of the Fokask Banner, which had a rather slanderous article written about Chief of State Leia Organa Solo.
lead_paragraphs: Fokask was a planet within the Fokask system in Outer Rim Territories. It was home to one of Han Solo's old smuggling friends. This retired smuggler sent Solo a copy of the Fokask Banner, which had a rather slanderous article written about Chief of State Leia Organa Solo.
